_: All timing lives here, read by Blender (shots), Node (captions, corner window) and sync/bleep.py. Times are song seconds. Video time v = song - start, frames are 1-based with v = (f-1)/30. To fix a late or early word, change its number and run: npm run zombies:proof. After changing a bleep, run sync/bleep.py first. Word times: forced aligner and Whisper on the Demucs vocal stem, snapped to the attack within 80 ms (src/zombies/sync/attacks.py). The 'notes' list every word placed by judgement rather than by the snap rule.
title: RESIDENT PARDO

notes.cut in: Band hit measured at 63.30 on the band stem. The voice is silent from 62.96 to 63.28, so pardutério can't leak.
notes.cut out: morra runs straight into the next line with no dip. Four Whisper passes put the next word at 96.96 to 96.98, so the song stops at 96.96. Least certain number in this file: check by ear.
notes.1 apocalipse: No attack within 80 ms, aligner time. The vowel runs on from pardo.
notes.12 o: Not really sung (aligner score 0.01, Whisper hears curraspado). Kept because it is in the written lyric.
notes.14 fodo: Placed on the f at 85.32, aligner time. The snap's 85.37 is the vowel, which is where the bleep sits.
notes.14 ate, a: Moved by hand. The snap put até on the 'do' syllable at 85.49. The spectrogram shows 'do' ending about 85.60, a gap, then até at 85.68. a is Whisper's 86.02.
notes.18 chupa rola: Whisper hears 'chupa a rola'. The written lyric aligns better (0.613 against 0.582), so it stays.
notes.20 se, engasga: Both snapped to 95.68. se keeps the attack, engasga is aligner time.
notes.20 ate, que, morra: Low aligner scores (0.07, 0.04, 0.24). Times come from the attacks, and Whisper's morra is later at 96.84.
